engine: Variation V1 of the day/night canon — the TOWNS dialect. A pill 'День / Ніч' with a sliding accent thumb that snaps the whole scene between a day still and a night still (opacity crossfade). Adds NO new motion engine: it builds the canon daynight-engine with mode:'manual' reveal:'opacity' glow:true and the pill calls dn.set(0|1); the variation owns only the pill chrome + the wiring. Harvested 1:1 from apps/towns plan.js (setMode) + app.css (.plan__daynight/.plan__dn-thumb).

drives_canon_with.note: the canon's built-in 'toggle' driver is a no-op (armToggle binds nothing) — the UI is the variation's job, so we use mode:'manual' and snap set(0)=day / set(1)=night ourselves.

dayMedia.what: url | selector | element — the frame-matched day still (canon bottom layer).

nightMedia.what: url | selector | element — the frame-matched night still, identical composition (canon top layer, revealed by opacity).

labels.what: [dayLabel, nightLabel] on the two pill buttons (Ukrainian).

accent.what: the sliding thumb fill (and :focus-visible ring). Warm brass to read premium on the dark track.

glow.what: warm window-glow that rises with t (canon layer). true | css-gradient string.

start.what: 0 = day on load (default) | 1 = night on load.

--dnt-on.what: active label colour (sits on the accent thumb).

--dnt-ease.what: thumb slide + label colour ease (one project ease).

seed_fidelity.crossfade: delegated to the canon opacity reveal (Towns scene CSS used a 0.7s opacity crossfade)

entry: DayNightToggle.create(target, opts) -> { root, set(t), get(), toggle(), day(), night(), pill, destroy }. target = element/selector. set(t) snaps day(<0.5)/night(>=0.5); get() returns the canon t; pill is the injected control element.
law: opacity + transform + gradient only; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO WebGL; keyboard accessible (real <button>s + arrow keys + :focus-visible); prefers-reduced-motion -> thumb transition removed (instant snap), canon statics the scene; frame-match rule inherited (only crossfade geometry-identical pairs). Requires the canon (window.DayNight) loaded FIRST. Sets window.__LAB_OK__.
proven: lab: OUR exterior day/night pair (renders/dn-ext-day.webp + dn-ext-night.webp). House loads in daylight, pill bottom-centre; demo taps 'Ніч' (~1.1s) — thumb slides translateX(100%), windows light up via the canon opacity crossfade — then returns to day (~4.2s); tapping the pill cancels the demo and is fully interactive. opacity-only crossfade = GPU.
